correctness.rationale: For d>=4 and positive side lengths, writing W=sum a_i|U_i|, L=norm(a), m=min a_i, k=minimum multiplicity and q=sqrt(L^2-m^2), each orthant is centered at a/L. Its cap first touches a coordinate facet exactly at t=q; unrestricted tail C(t)=2^(d-1) I_{1-t^2/L^2}((d-1)/2,1/2), exact for q<=t<=L, strictly exceeds true H for 0<t<q. Near q only k shortest facets leak, without double crossings because any two negative coordinates reduce maximum strictly below q. One-face tangent blowup in normal coordinate s=O(epsilon) and remaining d-2 tangential coordinates O(sqrt epsilon) yields coefficient [2^d k/(d*pi*m)](2/q)^((d-2)/2). Exact sphere-slicing integral G_d gives H=C-2^d k G_d; for d=4 integrates to the claimed elementary arcsin expression. Independent quadrature verified that analytic integral against direct one-coordinate integration for three 4D side profiles; no inference of uniformity in d. The boxes (1,2,3,4) and (1,sqrt5,sqrt8,4) indeed have same L,m,k and locally identical high-tail germs but differ globally.
